svg.aria-label: Channels: a private front door for workloads, outside AgentCore itself
svg.title: Channels: a private front door for workloads, outside AgentCore itself
svg.text: Channels: a private front door for workloads, outside AgentCore itself
IAM admits a workload once; which agents it may call is a deny-by-default allowlist edited in the platform. The serving deployment is not the console.
Management plane (not on the serving path)

① SigV4 into a private API ② through the caller's execute-api endpoint ③ VPC Link → internal NLB ④ entry-only pods (same image as the console) ⑤ governed invoke · 202 + poll, because agent runs outlive front-door timeouts
